title.narrative: Support to Rights

description.narrative: The Overall Objective of the contract is to contribute to strengthening participatory democracy by improving the resilience of human rights organizations (HROs) in TurkeyThe Specific Objectives of the contract is to increase the capacity of small scale HROs (especially those located in eastern and south-eastern region or working on issues related to minorities and discrimination) to operate independently and to sustain their operations through an improved organizational strength, a better access to diversified sources of funds and ability to form/reach formal/informal networks of HROs.
